# Screenplay upstream revision

What final audiovisual realization proves wrong in scripts, treatments, or settings, and what is repaired there. Every selected screenplay H2, H3, and H4 answers for its actual script parent and any earlier owner implicated by the finding.

## Script and canon revision from screenplay work {#script-and-canon-revision-from-screenplay-work}

Final screenplay is the last authoring layer that can expose an inherited defect before source realization. Report the exact defect it reveals: an emotional consequence nothing upstream earned, access or information order that cannot survive dramatization, progression that reads as arbitrary when seen and heard, a settings fact that becomes visibly false, or a subject drive unable to carry the final action or line. Repair the earliest owning script, treatment, or settings unit and propagate downward; audiovisual polish may not compensate for an unchosen parent decision.

`@evidence` names every upstream target repaired and the visible, audible, rhythmic, or dramatic realization that exposed it. When this unit exposes no defect, `@evidenceExclude` names its actual script parent and the concrete consequence, access, progression, fact, and drive realized without alteration. A silent pass, parentless unit, or repeated sufficiency sentence covers nothing.

Review question: what did realizing this screenplay unit prove wrong in its actual script, treatment, or settings parents, or which concrete parent decisions did it test and find sufficient?

Sources: [Detailed Outline Control on controlled refinement from outline to final text](https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.190/); [George Mason University on revising content and organization before sentence form](https://writingcenter.gmu.edu/writing-resources/writing-as-process/revising)

# Script upstream revision

What partitioning and staging a script proves wrong in treatments or settings, and what is repaired there. Every selected script H2, H3, and H4 answers for every actual treatment parent it realizes.

## Treatment and settings revision from script work {#treatment-and-settings-revision-from-script-work}

Execution makes a treatment's gaps measurable. Report the exact parent defect it exposes: a turn with no executable middle, a connection that fails when positions and timings become concrete, a decision with no genuine alternative once resources are real, summarized dialogue whose actual exchange changes the outcome, or a settings fact too imprecise for the scene. Repair the earliest owner and propagate through treatment; a script-local participant, capability, limit, or refusal leaves its parents wrong.

`@evidence` names every upstream target repaired and the staging decision that exposed it. When this unit exposes no defect, `@evidenceExclude` names its actual treatment parents and the concrete turns, connections, alternatives, exchanges, resources, and settings precision found executable. A silent pass, parentless unit, or shared stock sentence covers nothing.

Review question: what did staging this script unit prove wrong in its actual treatment or settings parents, or which concrete parent decisions did it test and find sufficient?

Sources: [Detailed Outline Control on outline-to-draft control](https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.190/); [NASA on reviewing plausible causes and affected areas](https://swehb.nasa.gov/spaces/SWEHBVC/pages/50889445/SWE-204%2B-%2BProcess%2BAssessments)

# Treatment upstream revision

What writing a treatment proves wrong in settings, and what is repaired there. Every selected treatment H2 answers for the settings facts it actually uses.

## Settings revision from treatment work {#settings-revision-from-treatment-work}

Treatment is the first practical test of canon. Report the exact parent defect it exposes: a fact too loose to use, incompatible constraints, a subject whose established drives cannot produce the needed turn, a participant with no settings owner, or an unresolved value without which progression cannot be chosen. Repair the settings H2 that owns it and inherit the repair; a treatment-local alternative, refusal, capability, or limit is not an upstream correction.

`@evidence` names every settings target repaired and what authoring this unit exposed. When this unit exposes no defect, `@evidenceExclude` names the concrete settings facts, constraints, subjects, and drives tested and why they were sufficient for this progression. A silent pass, parentless unit, "no change needed", or sentence repeated across units covers nothing.

Review question: what did authoring this treatment unit prove wrong in its actual settings parents, or which concrete parent decisions did it test and find sufficient?

Sources: [Detailed Outline Control on moving creative decisions upstream](https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.190/); [NASA on distinguishing symptom removal from root-cause correction](https://swehb.nasa.gov/spaces/SWEHBVC/pages/50889445/SWE-204%2B-%2BProcess%2BAssessments)
